sourceProjection.basis: The Palatine Gallery and royal-apartment illustration is an overhead plan with room boundaries and numbered anchors. Historical publication status does not change this projection assessment.

review: Museum-published 2018 guide sample, p9 orthographic Palatine Gallery and royal apartments. All 29 numbered rooms extracted from the plan, excluding legend/list and external labels. Blue CAD fill paths define walls; isolated narrow repetitive strips are stair treads kept flat. Numbering is historical source inventory, not a promise of current exhibit placement. p6 Treasury/Mezzanine raster plan is too low-resolution to classify room boundaries reliably, and is not replaced by made-up geometry.
limitations: 本图覆盖帕拉蒂纳画廊与王室公寓所在一层，保留导览图全部 29 个编号。
底层珍宝馆、夹层及其他馆区尚待补齐可辨识平面，没有使用推测楼层填充。
编号依据馆方出版导览图，展品位置与开放情况仍须现场核对；墙高为示意。
